texto_fixo.trava: CHARACTER LOCK: Light Yagami from Death Note. Appearance: Neat brown hair, sharp confident eyes, school uniform or dark coat, smug smirk, calm composed look. Keep exactly the same face, hairstyle, eye color, outfit and colors in every image.
texto_fixo.estilo: ART STYLE: 2D anime / cartoon illustration style like a Gacha Life reaction video, clean line art, flat cel shading, vibrant colors.
texto_fixo.regras: Framing: the character is SITTING on an invisible seat as if on a couch or a cinema seat (the pose says from where we see them: three-quarters, from the front or from BEHIND); seen from the front or three-quarters: head, both arms, torso and the thighs/knees visible, cropped around the knees at the bottom edge; seen from behind: the back of the head, shoulders and upper back, cropped at the waist; whole head and hair inside the image with margin. Do NOT draw the couch, chair, seat, table, TV or any other object. ONE single figure, no text, no panels, on a flat solid chroma-key green background (#00FF00), no shadow on the background.
